items.stem: In PRINCE2 Agile's fix/flex approach for a release with a hard launch date, which variable is typically FIXED while scope flexes?

options.text: Time, so the team delivers the most valuable scope achievable by the date
options.rationale: Correct: PRINCE2 Agile often fixes time and cost and flexes scope by prioritisation.

options.text: Scope, delivering every planned feature no matter the date
options.rationale: Fixing scope against a hard date is the traditional assumption PRINCE2 Agile avoids.

options.text: Quality tolerances, lowered freely to hit the date
options.rationale: Quality is protected, not casually traded away.

options.text: Benefits, which are abandoned to save time
options.rationale: Benefits are the point of the project, not a flex variable to abandon.

items.explanation: Correct: PRINCE2 Agile often fixes time and cost and flexes scope by prioritisation.

items.stem: Why does an agile team benefit from being run inside PRINCE2 governance on a larger project?

options.text: It adds direction, business justification and controlled stage boundaries the team alone may lack
options.rationale: Correct: PRINCE2 supplies governance and justification around agile delivery.

options.text: It forces the team to abandon iterations
It removes the need for any customer involvement
It guarantees no change can occur
options.rationale: Agile embraces change; governance manages it.

items.explanation: Correct: PRINCE2 supplies governance and justification around agile delivery.

items.stem: Which TWO statements correctly describe PRINCE2 Agile's view of combining the approaches? (Select TWO)

options.text: PRINCE2 provides governance while agile provides flexible delivery
options.rationale: Correct: the combination pairs governance with flexible delivery.

options.text: Tailoring is used to adapt themes and processes for agile working
options.rationale: Correct: tailoring is how PRINCE2 flexes to agile delivery.

options.text: Agile delivery means the project board is no longer needed
Combining them means dropping the PRINCE2 principles
Fixing and flexing applies only to cost
options.rationale: Several variables are considered, not cost alone.

items.explanation: Correct: the combination pairs governance with flexible delivery. Correct: tailoring is how PRINCE2 flexes to agile delivery.
